name: WatsonOM-ImmediateMemorySweep
description: One-shot bootstrap sweep to run on the next heartbeat after registration/startup.

payload.message: BOOTSTRAP OM SWEEP. On the next heartbeat, run `python3 scripts/token_tracker.py report --date $(date -u +%F) --write` and `python3 scripts/token_tracker.py status --date $(date -u +%F)` to create the initial Codex-only expenditure snapshot for the day. Then check `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` plus the rest of `memory/` for stale transcript dumps, flag any orphaned file over 200 lines for relocation to `reports/openclaw/`, verify `MEMORY.md` is still compact, and leave a short audit note describing what needs cleanup or confirming no action was needed.
